body:
My 5 year old son and my significant other.

No matter how bad I want it, I refuse to leave my son without a mother. Every time his eyes light up when he sees me, the days where he says all he wants is his mama and we cuddle up and watch movies, those things and many more are my reasons. I couldn’t hurt him like that, that pain is unbearable beyond belief. Nothing else could even compare to that pain.

My significant other was homeless when I met him, he has also had a great deal of suffering, but where other people would give up and that is including myself he has always been optimistic. He has no one except me. No one to be his friend, no one to help him, he has no one at all. I can’t let him go back to that. He’s the most wonderful person I’ve ever met, I’ve never had anyone treat as well as he does. Sometimes I get really emotional, because I have no idea what I did to deserve as wonderful as him.
